messages.subject: Load .rda file into R
parts:
Hello Rists. I saved an .rda file with save() of a list of 17000+
[[elements]], each with 10 [elements]. The file size is 38 MB. I've
tried to load it back into R with load() on both my Mac (OS X 10.6.4)
and on my Windows 7 computers, but after many minutes (30+) neither
finishes completing the task. It seems to be using a lot of memory, as
both computers become very slow in other applications. I simply have
to force quit R.

Has anyone had this problem? Any ideas? I don't want to lose the work
I did to create that mega-list, if possible. Thanks. Earl Brown
